name: patent-audit
title_zh: 316 项清单逐条过，递交前先拆穿自家专利的致命伤
tagline_zh: 别等 USPTO 审查员替你找茬。递交前跑一遍法定门槛、发明人、期限三关，再派并行审查员撕说明书、权利要求。
tagline_en: Don't let the examiner find it first. Pre-filing gate on statute, inventorship, deadlines, then parallel.
desc_en: Audit a draft U.S. utility patent application before it is filed, against a 316-item checklist grounded in 35 U.S.C., 37 CFR, the MPEP, and current USPTO practice. why_zh: 不是泛泛润色，而是把 35 U.S.C.、37 CFR、MPEP 编成 316 项确定性预检。
why_en: Not a polish pass—it encodes 35 U.S.C., 37 CFR, MPEP into 316 deterministic checks, then pits parallel review agents against.
limit_zh: 只审美国实用专利申请草案，不覆盖外观设计、PCT 或已授权专利的复审。需要完整草案文本（含权利要求和附图）。
limit_en: US utility patent drafts only—no design, PCT, or post-grant. Needs full draft incl. claims & drawings. Outputs audit report + suggestions, not.
title_en: 316-point pre-filing audit that kills fatal patent flaws
